summary:
Sempra Energy EPS 超預期 6.9%，但營收年減 3.9%，盤後下跌 0.34%，31.4 倍本益比偏高，LNG 基礎設施業務是長期成長引擎但短期收入承壓。
• EPS $1.58 超越預估 $1.48，驚喜幅度 +6.9%，費用控制帶動 EPS 超越但未能彌補收入下滑疑慮。
• 單季營收 $36.55 億美元，年減 3.9%，為本批次中少數營收年減的個股，能源市場定價波動影響收入。
• 本益比 31.4 倍，市值 $603 億美元，對公用事業股屬偏高估值，LNG 基礎設施成長溢價支撐。
• 盤後股價下跌 0.34%，即便 EPS 超預期仍收跌，市場對收入年減及公用事業前景持謹慎態度。
• 收入年減 -3.9% 在公用事業股中屬負面訊號，尤其在 31.4 倍本益比下，市場要求更高的收入確定性。
ai_view:
Sempra Energy 本季呈現「獲利管控超越但收入下滑」的矛盾格局——6.9% EPS 驚喜反映費用控制能力，但 -3.9% 的收入年減使市場難以給予正面評價，盤後微跌印證這一解讀。在公用事業領域，收入的可預測性與穩定成長是估值溢價的基礎，當收入出現年減時，任何 EPS 超預期的說服力均大打折扣。Sempra 的核心長期價值在於 LNG 基礎設施業務——美國 LNG 出口需求結構性成長、歐洲能源安全多元化政策支持，都為 Sempra 的 LNG 計畫提供長期需求能見度。短期而言，收入年減構成阻力；中期而言，若 LNG 出口計畫按期推進且電力公用事業（SoCal Gas、SDG&E）需求回升，Sempra 具備一定的成長重評價空間。需追蹤指標：LNG 出口計畫進展（Port Arthur LNG 動工時程）、加州電力事業電費調整申請進展、收入能否在下季轉為正增長、以及監管環境對基礎設施投資的影響。整體評估，屬偏向保守的公用事業加 LNG 成長股混合型標的，適合穩健型投資人觀察。

需留意：收入年減 -3.9% 顯示能源市場定價或業務量有所下滑，若趨勢持續，EPS 超預期帶來的支撐將難以長期維持。；31.4 倍本益比對公用事業股偏高，在高利率環境下，高股息收益率的替代品（債券）競爭可能壓縮估值。；LNG 基礎設施（Cameron LNG 等）計畫執行風險、環境許可延遲可能影響長期成長路徑的兌現時程。

summary_en:
Sempra beat EPS by 6.9% but revenue declined -3.9% YoY; a -0.34% post-earnings dip and 31.4x P/E reflect investor focus on revenue contraction despite earnings resilience.
• EPS of $1.58 beat the $1.48 estimate by 6.9%; cost management drove EPS outperformance but couldn't offset revenue contraction concerns.
• Revenue of $3.66B declined -3.9% YoY—one of the few YoY revenue declines in this batch, reflecting energy market pricing fluctuations.
• P/E of 31.4x on a $60.3B market cap is above utility sector averages; LNG infrastructure growth premium provides partial justification.
• Post-earnings stock fell -0.34% despite the EPS beat, reflecting market caution about revenue decline and utilities sector outlook.
• A -3.9% revenue decline is a negative signal for a utility stock at 31.4x P/E; the market demands higher revenue certainty at this multiple.

ai_view_en:
Sempra's quarter presents a 'strong EPS control, weak revenue' contradiction—the 6.9% EPS beat reflects cost management capability, but the -3.9% YoY revenue decline prevents a positive market reception, confirmed by the -0.34% post-earnings move. In utilities, revenue predictability and stable growth underpin the valuation premium; when revenue declines, EPS beats carry reduced credibility. Sempra's core long-term value lies in LNG infrastructure—structural US LNG export demand growth and European energy security diversification support long-term demand visibility for Sempra's LNG projects. Near-term, revenue decline creates a headwind. Medium-term, if LNG export projects advance on schedule and California utility demand recovers, there is upside re-rating potential. Key metrics: LNG export project progress (Port Arthur LNG construction timeline), California utility rate case outcomes, revenue trajectory reverting to positive growth, and regulatory environment for infrastructure investment. A conservative utility-plus-LNG-growth hybrid name suitable for monitoring by income-oriented investors.

Watch：Revenue decline of -3.9% YoY signals energy pricing or volume headwinds; if this trend persists, EPS outperformance cannot be sustained through cost cuts alone.; A 31.4x P/E is elevated for utilities; in a high-rate environment, bond yield competition could compress the multiple further.; LNG infrastructure project execution risk (Cameron LNG, Port Arthur LNG) and environmental permit delays could affect the timeline for long-term growth realization.
beat_or_miss: 超預期 EPS 實際 $1.58 超越預估 $1.48，驚喜幅度 +6.9%，屬正向超預期但收入年減令人關注。
